blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Court of Tax Appeals (CTA) sentenced nine people, including a boat captain and a driver, to prison after they pleaded guilty in two cases under the Anti-Agricultural Economic Sabotage Act. In separate orders dated Sept. 29, the CTA Third Division found all nine guilty of violating Section 7(g) of Republic Act No. 12022, which penalizes knowingly transporting or storing smuggled agricultural and fishery products.
